meta.name: claude-md-enhancer
meta.description: Analyzes, generates, and enhances CLAUDE.md files for any project type using best practices, modular architecture support, and tech stack customization. Use when setting up new projects, improving existing CLAUDE.md files, or establishing AI-assisted development standards.

copy.tagline: 为项目生成和优化AI协作配置文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目创建或改进CLAUDE.md文件以提升AI协作效率。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and optimize AI collaboration config files for projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or improve CLAUDE.md files for better AI collaboration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的项目，生成或改进 CLAUDE.md 文件，包括项目结构、技术栈、工作流程等，并确保符合官方格式。
howto.when: 当你要求创建、分析或增强 CLAUDE.md 文件时触发，例如新项目初始化或现有文件优化。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目创建一个 CLAUDE.md 文件。
say.note: Claude 会探索仓库并生成定制文件。

say.text: 分析我当前的 CLAUDE.md 文件，告诉我缺少什么。
say.note: Claude 会扫描并给出改进建议。

say.text: 为我的 TypeScript React 项目增强 CLAUDE.md。
say.note: Claude 会添加缺失部分并优化结构。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your project to generate or improve CLAUDE.md files, including project structure, tech stack, workflows, and ensures compliance with official format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create, analyze, or enhance a CLAUDE.md file, e.g., for new project setup or existing file optimization.

say_en.text: Create a CLAUDE.md file for this project.
say_en.note: Claude explores the repo and generates a customized file.

say_en.text: Analyze my current CLAUDE.md and tell me what's missing.
say_en.note: Claude scans and provides improvement suggestions.

say_en.text: Enhance my CLAUDE.md for a TypeScript React project.
say_en.note: Claude adds missing sections and optimizes structure.
